title: 追赶趋势与真正追平
premise: 扫描降速后磁盘等待下降，开始核验回放速度及订单新鲜度。
listeningTask: 区分正在追赶、达到固定标记和持续稳定。

lines.en: The replica is catching up now. Replay runs faster than new WAL arrives.
lines.zh: 副本现在正在追赶，回放速度超过新WAL到达速度。

lines.en: Good trend, but show the remaining gap. A falling timer isn't enough proof.
lines.zh: 趋势不错，但要展示剩余差距，计时数下降不足以证明。

lines.en: The byte gap is shrinking too. Our known order appears on B.
lines.zh: 字节差距也在缩小，已知订单已出现在B。

lines.en: Just to confirm, newer orders too, right? One old marker doesn't prove freshness.
lines.zh: 确认一下，也查更新的订单，对吧？一个旧标记不能证明新鲜度。

lines.en: I'll compare newly committed markers repeatedly. Record primary positions with each check.
lines.zh: 我反复对比新提交标记，每次都记录对应主库位置。

lines.en: The replay position reached our latest marker. About ten seconds behind current writes.
lines.zh: 回放位置达到最新测试标记，离当前写入大约还有十秒。

lines.en: Let it catch up before restoring traffic. Keep primary routing for sensitive reads.
lines.zh: 恢复流量前让它继续追平，敏感读仍走主库。

lines.en: So, let's keep it under observation. Maybe five stable minutes after matching markers.
lines.zh: 那继续观察，标记匹配后再稳定观察五分钟左右。

lines.en: Include disk queues and replay errors. Fresh samples alone miss recurring pressure.
lines.zh: 也检查磁盘队列和回放错误，只有新鲜样本会漏掉复发压力。

lines.en: If replication lag is climbing again, stop. I'll keep the routing change ready.
lines.zh: 如果复制延迟再上升就停止，我会保留路由变更准备。

scene: 扫描降速后磁盘等待下降，开始核验回放速度及订单新鲜度。
accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）
